+++ b/tests/test_indeterminate_tasks.py
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+from unittest import TestCase
+
+from mistune import create_markdown
+
+
+class TestIndeterminateTasks(TestCase):
+    def test_ast_marker_and_attributes(self):
+        md = create_markdown(renderer="ast", plugins=["task_lists"])
+        token = md("- [-] todo\n")[0]["children"][0]
+        self.assertEqual(token["type"], "task_list_item")
+        self.assertEqual(token["attrs"], {"checked": False, "indeterminate": True})
+        self.assertEqual(token["children"][0]["children"], [{"type": "text", "raw": "todo"}])
+
+    def test_html_mixed_checkbox(self):
+        md = create_markdown(plugins=["task_lists"])
+        html = md("- [-] todo\n")
+        self.assertIn('class="task-list-item"', html)
+        self.assertIn('type="checkbox"', html)
+        self.assertIn('aria-checked="mixed"', html)
+        self.assertIn('data-indeterminate="true"', html)
+        self.assertRegex(html, r"<input\b[^>]*\sdisabled(?:\s|/|>)")
+        self.assertNotRegex(html, r"<input\b[^>]*\schecked(?:\s|=|/|>)")
+        self.assertNotIn("[-]", html)
+
+    def test_nested_items_are_rewritten(self):
+        md = create_markdown(renderer="ast", plugins=["task_lists"])
+        tokens = md("> - [-] outer\n>   - [-] inner\n")
+        pending = list(tokens)
+        tasks = []
+        while pending:
+            token = pending.pop()
+            pending.extend(token.get("children", []))
+            if token["type"] == "task_list_item":
+                tasks.append(token["attrs"])
+        self.assertEqual(tasks, [{"checked": False, "indeterminate": True}] * 2)
+
+    def test_existing_markers_and_missing_space(self):
+        md = create_markdown(renderer="ast", plugins=["task_lists"])
+        for mark, checked in (("[ ]", False), ("[x]", True), ("[X]", True)):
+            token = md("- " + mark + " todo\n")[0]["children"][0]
+            self.assertEqual(token["attrs"], {"checked": checked})
+        token = md("- [-]word\n")[0]["children"][0]
+        self.assertEqual(token["type"], "list_item")
+        html = create_markdown(plugins=["task_lists"])("- [x] done\n")
+        self.assertNotIn('aria-checked="mixed"', html)
+        self.assertNotIn('data-indeterminate="true"', html)

spec.question: Add an indeterminate task marker, [-], to the task_lists plugin. It must have the same leading-marker and following-whitespace requirements as the existing checkbox markers and work in nested lists and block quotes. Its AST list-item token must have type task_list_item and attrs exactly {"checked": false, "indeterminate": true}, with the marker and its following whitespace removed from the first child's text. In HTML, render the usual disabled checkbox without a checked attribute, adding aria-checked="mixed" and data-indeterminate="true" to that input. Keep existing [ ], [x], and [X] AST attributes and HTML output unchanged; [-] without following whitespace must stay literal. Return a unified diff against production files only.
